assertions.assertion: The claim was denied under CARC CO-50
The denial was on the basis that the service was not medically necessary
The service at issue is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry
The service is billed under CPT 93229
There is a clinical indication note documenting the case
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10
The patient has intermittent episodes of palpitations
The palpitations are accompanied by dizziness and giddiness
Dizziness and giddiness are coded as R42
There is a separate 'ordering note' document
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to assess for ischemic changes
The patient has known coronary artery disease
The documented indications meet the clinical criteria for this diagnostic modality
The appellant requests reconsideration of the determination
The denial applies to this specific episode/encounter
